siteSettings.heroSupportingText: Explore contemporary women's fashion at Modern Maharani, KPHB.
siteSettings.introCopy: Modern Maharani brings together contemporary women's fashion for women who want to feel confident, stylish and effortlessly themselves.
siteSettings.storeSectionHeading: Come See It. Feel It. Try It.
siteSettings.storeSectionCopy: Some outfits just look better when you see them in person. Visit Modern Maharani at KPHB and explore the collection for yourself.
siteSettings.metaTitle: Modern Maharani | Women's Fashion Showroom in KPHB, Kukatpally, Hyderabad
siteSettings.metaDescription: Discover contemporary women's fashion, Kurtis, dresses, and occasion wear at Modern Maharani in KPHB, Kukatpally, Hyderabad. Visit our digital showroom today.

products.name: Pure Handloom Kota Cotton (Kutch Work & Mirror Borders)
products.description: Pure Kota Doria cotton fabric with handcrafted Kutchi geometric threadwork along the neck yoke and real micro-mirror borders. Includes lightweight breathable dupatta.

products.name: Semi-Kota Block Printed Suit Set
products.description: Semi-Kota blended fabric adorned with traditional floral block prints, paired with a printed matching cotton-blend dupatta.

products.name: Fine Chanderi Cotton Silk Suit Material
products.description: Lightweight mercerized Chanderi weave top with fine zari patti borders, plain Shantoon bottom, and gold woven organza dupatta.

products.name: Raw Silk Suit with Jamdani Woven Booties
products.description: 100% natural Raw Silk top featuring authentic Jacquard/Jamdani extra-weft thread booties (not printed), matching raw silk bottom, and rich woven dupatta.

products.name: Jute Silk Suit with Hand Maggam & Zardozi Yoke
products.description: Textured raw Jute Silk featuring antique gold zari embroidery, cutwork beads, micro-pearl Maggam craft on the neckline, accompanied by sheer organza dupatta.

products.name: Pure Tussar Silk with Floral Thread Kantha Motifs
products.description: Earthy textured wild Tussar silk top panel decorated with multi-colored thread embroidery, paired with solid silk bottom and matching embroidered Tussar dupatta.

products.name: Tissue & Semi-Tussar Festive Suit Set
products.description: Metallic dual-tone sheen tissue weave with subtle gold zari borders and a printed tissue silk dupatta.

products.name: Authentic Ajrakh Natural Dye Block Print Set
products.description: Hand-carved wooden block prints using indigo and madder red vegetable dyes on modal silk/chanderi with a large 2.5m Ajrakh dupatta.

products.name: Kalamkari Silk Suit Set
products.description: Traditional pen-work and screen-printed mythological and tree-of-life floral motifs on soft silk fabric.

products.name: Elephant & Tropical Motif Sanganeri Print Suit
products.description: High-twist premium cotton featuring heritage elephant and coconut palm tree border designs with a dual-shade printed dupatta.

products.name: Chikankari Embroidered Straight Kurta-Pant Set
products.description: Pre-stitched straight-fit cotton kurta with Lucknowi chikankari floral shadow-work, matching tapered cigarette pants, and soft chiffon dupatta.

products.name: Festive Threadwork Anarkali 3-Piece Ensemble
products.description: Georgette gathered flared kurta with intricate resham embroidery, churidar bottom, and border-finished dupatta.

products.name: Tiered Jaipur Cotton Vacation Frock
products.description: Multi-tiered relaxed-fit maxi dress with bohemian block prints and tasseled tie-ups at neck. 100% breathable cambric cotton.

products.name: Floor-Length Festive Anarkali Gown
products.description: Heavy Kalidar flare floor-length gown featuring foil print borders and a padded bustier with side zip closure.

products.name: Linen-Blend Tunic & Wide-Leg Palazzo Co-ord Set
products.description: Relaxed monochromatic co-ord silhouette featuring notched collar, 3/4 sleeves, and ethnic wooden button accents.

products.name: Asymmetrical Fusion High-Low Midi Tunic
products.description: Slit-front modern Indo-Western kurti styled specifically for pairing with jeans or trousers.

products.name: Velvet Crop Top & Flared Skirt Lehenga Set with Organza Shrug
products.description: Heavy sequin work velvet blouse, digital floral printed georgette skirt with built-in can-can lining, and a sheer cape cover-up.

products.name: Straight-Cut Formal Office Kurti (Rayon Slub)
products.description: Minimalist mandarin collar, subtle geometric patti work, dual side pockets, and functional side slits.

products.name: A-Line Casual Everyday Cotton Kurti
products.description: Lightweight everyday comfort A-line fit with contrast piping along the neckline.

products.name: Pure Handloom Kota Doria Saree with Zari Border
products.description: 6.3m drape including unstitched blouse piece. Signature square checkered khat weave with woven gold tissue border.

products.name: Muslin Jamdani Floral Weave Saree
products.description: Featherweight transparent muslin weave with distinct supplementary weft floral patterns woven across the body and pallu.

products.name: Gadwal Pattu Saree with Kuttu Temple Borders
products.description: Contrast color silk body with hand-interlocked (Kuttu) golden zari borders and grand temple motifs woven on the pallu.

products.name: Dual-Tone Soft Silk Saree with Antique Silver Weave
products.description: Lightweight art silk with buttery soft drape, dual-shade cross-color luster, and all-over silver brocade weave.

products.name: Kalamkari Printed Flowing Chiffon Saree
products.description: Weightless chiffon fabric printed with heritage floral pen-style artwork and a contrasting satin border.

products.name: Daily-Wear Organic Linen-Cotton Saree
products.description: Breathable textured drape with yarn-dyed stripes and hand-knotted pom-pom tassels on the pallu.

products.name: Budget Raw Silk 3-Piece Material Set
products.description: Affordable woven booties raw silk top, plain matching bottom, and silk blend dupatta. Exceptional wholesale value.

products.name: Everyday Cotton Kurti Trio Pack
products.description: Value bundle of 3 printed daily-wear straight cotton office kurtis in complementary colors.

products.name: Premium Cotton Elephant-Themed Suit Set
products.description: Includes free shipping badge, heavy floral/elephant border print, and contrasting printed dupatta.

products.name: Semi-Kota Mirror Work Suit Set
products.description: Budget-friendly festive suit featuring machine mirror work yoke embellishment on semi-kota fabric.

reviews.reviewText: Modern Maharani at KPHB has the best contemporary Kurti and Dress collections! The fabrics feel so premium and comfortable.
Visited the store opposite Global Eye Hospital last week. Beautiful ambiance and lovely occasion wear! Enquired on WhatsApp first and they kept it ready for me to try.
Super stylish dresses and daily wear Kurtis. Loved the showroom shopping experience in Kukatpally.
